WITH target_product AS (
  SELECT l.product_id
  FROM stock_lots l JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id
  WHERE l.is_deleted=false AND w.code='HQ-001' AND l.lot_no='2026/08/08-8'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT w.code AS warehouse_code,w.name AS warehouse_name,
       COALESCE(b.available_qty,0) AS available_qty,
       COALESCE(b.reserved_qty,0) AS reserved_qty,
       COALESCE(b.total_qty,0) AS total_qty
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN target_product p ON true
LEFT JOIN stock_balances b ON b.product_id=p.product_id AND b.warehouse_id=w.id AND b.is_deleted=false
WHERE w.is_deleted=false AND w.code IN ('HQ-001','00003')
ORDER BY w.code;
WITH target_product AS (

  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.total_qty),0) AS all_warehouse_total
FROM stock_balances b JOIN target_product p ON p.product_id=b.product_id
WHERE b.is_deleted=false;

SELECT t.transfer_no,t.status,w.code AS warehouse_code,m.movement_type,m.quantity_delta,m.note
FROM stock_movements m
JOIN stock_transfers t ON t.id=m.reference_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=m.warehouse_id
WHERE t.transfer_no='2026/08/13-1'
ORDER BY m.occurred_at,m.movement_type;
SELECT t.transfer_no,l.requested_quantity,l.shipped_quantity,l.received_quantity,
       sl.unit_cost AS destination_unit_cost
FROM stock_transfer_lines l
JOIN stock_transfers t ON t.id=l.transfer_id
LEFT JOIN stock_lots sl ON sl.id=l.destination_lot_id
WHERE t.transfer_no='2026/08/13-1';
